name: Manas Bakshi

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Manas Bakshi is a Kolkata-based English-language poet whose writing also extends to the economic history of rural Bengal. His doctorate at the University of Calcutta examined the transition from feudalism to capitalism, and his academic books explore agrarian change and land reform. His poetry collections include In the Age of Living Death, The Midnight Star and Soliloquy of a Sailor.

His Kabita Live poem ‘Tacitly So’ starts with marks on graph paper and follows what those marks cannot fully preserve. Bricks lose a mason’s fingerprints, discarded letters lose the trace of a postman, and felled trees can no longer invite rain. These ordinary remains turn into a meditation on forgotten labour, ecological loss and the way time erases evidence of a life.
